Semester 8: Internship

Read the summary line. If it feels unfamiliar, open the chapter and study the diagram.

Internship (Intensive Practicum)

Community Health Nursing Internship

  • Community health internship — 4 weeks of supervised practice in family health, home visits, camps and records.
  • Describe the objectives of a community internship
  • Perform family and home care in the community

Internship (Intensive Practicum)

Adult Health Nursing Internship

  • Adult health nursing internship — 6 weeks of clinical practice in medical-surgical wards, ICU and emergency care.
  • Describe the objectives of the adult health internship
  • Plan care for medical and surgical patients

Internship (Intensive Practicum)

Child Health Nursing Internship

  • Child health internship — 4 weeks of supervised practice in paediatric wards: feeding, play, growth and IMNCI care.
  • Describe the objectives of a child health internship
  • Care for sick children and their families

Internship (Intensive Practicum)

Mental Health Nursing Internship

  • Mental health internship — 4 weeks of supervised practice in psychiatric units: assessment, communication, safety and rehabilitation.
  • Describe the objectives of a mental health internship
  • Perform mental status assessment

Internship (Intensive Practicum)

Midwifery Internship

  • Midwifery internship — 4 weeks of supervised practice in antenatal, labour, delivery, postnatal and newborn care.
  • Describe the objectives of a midwifery internship
  • Conduct antenatal and intrapartum care
